
         ent  $

START    call MAKETAB
         ei

         ld   bc,0
LOOP1    push bc
LOOP2    push bc
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc
         inc  c
         jr   nz,LOOP2
         pop  af
         inc  a
         cp   192
         ld   b,a
         jr   c,LOOP1

CLEAR    ld   hl,0
CLEAR2   push hl
         call RANDOM
         ld   a,h
         cp   192
         jr   c,CLEAR3
         sub  128
CLEAR3   ld   c,l
         ld   b,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  hl
         dec  hl
         ld   a,h
         or   l
         jr   nz,CLEAR2

NO_STARS equ  25

STARS    ld   b,NO_STARS
         ld   ix,SPACE
STARS2   call RANDOM
         ld   a,h
         and  63
         add  a,64
         ld   (ix+0),l
         ld   (ix+1),a
         call RANDOM
         ld   a,l
         and  7
         inc  a
         ld   (ix+2),a
         ld   de,3
         add  ix,de
         djnz STARS2
         jr   STARS7

STARS5   ld   ix,SPACE
         ld   b,NO_STARS
STARS4   push bc
         ld   c,(ix+0)
         ld   b,(ix+1)
         call PLOT3
         ld   de,3
         add  ix,de
         pop  bc
         djnz STARS4

STARS7   ld   ix,SPACE
         ld   b,NO_STARS
STARS3   push bc
         ld   a,(ix+2)
         ld   c,(ix+0)
         add  a,c
         ld   c,a
         ld   (ix+0),a
         ld   b,(ix+1)
         call PLOT3
         ld   de,3
         add  ix,de
         pop  bc
         djnz STARS3
         ld   a,0
         out  (254),a
         halt
         ld   a,4
         out  (254),a
         call 8020
         ret  nc
         jr   STARS5

PLOT3    ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/512
         add  hl,hl
         ld   a,(hl)
         inc  l
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,l
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         and  7
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         xor  (hl)
         ld   (hl),a
         ret

MAKETAB  ld   b,192
         ld   de,16384
         ld   hl,SCRNADRS
MAKETAB2 ld   (hl),e
         inc  hl
         ld   (hl),d
         inc  hl
         ex   de,hl
         call DOWNHL
         ex   de,hl
         djnz MAKETAB2
         ret

RANDOM   ld   de,0
         ld   h,e
         ld   l,253
         ld   a,d
         or   a
         sbc  hl,de
         sbc  a,0
         sbc  hl,de
         sbc  a,0
         ld   e,a
         ld   d,0
         sbc  hl,de
         jr   nc,AB
         inc  hl
AB       ld   (RANDOM+1),hl
         ret

LAST
A0LEN    equ  $-START

         org  LAST/512+1*512

SCRNADRS defs 512

TABLE    defb 128,64,32,16
         defb 8,4,2,1

SPACE    defs 3*NO_STARS

PLOT1    ld   a,b
         call #22B1
         ld   b,a
         inc  b
         ld   a,1
PLOT1A   rrca
         djnz PLOT1A
         xor  (hl)
         ld   (hl),a
         ret

PLOT2    ld   a,b
         and  a
         rra
         scf
         rra
         and  a
         rra
         xor  b
         and  #F8
         xor  b
         ld   h,a
         ld   a,c
         rlca
         rlca
         rlca
         xor  b
         and  %11000111
         xor  b
         rlca
         rlca
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         and  7

         add  a,a
         add  a,a
         add  a,a
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,254
         sub  b
         ld   (CODE+1),a
CODE     set  0,(hl)
         ret

UPHL     ld   a,h
         dec  h
         and  7
         ret  nz
         ld   a,l
         sub  32
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         jr   c,UPHL2
         add  a,8
         ld   h,a
UPHL2    cp   64
         ret  nc
         ld   h,87
         ret


DOWNHL   inc  h
         ld   a,h
         and  7
         ret  nz
         ld   a,l
         add  a,32
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         jr   c,DOWNHL2
         sub  8
         ld   h,a
DOWNHL2  cp   88
         ret  c
         ld   h,64
         ret
